zh: 当你在键盘前坐了太久，Keeper 会把屏幕缓缓染成一片颜色；等你确实回到工作上，它又缓缓退去。它不拦截任何操作，也不要求你做什么——只是换掉屋里的光。
en: When you have been at the keyboard too long, Keeper slowly fades your screen into a colour, and fades away again once you are clearly back at work. Nothing is blocked, nothing is demanded — it just changes the light.

zh: 一行一个时间块。不晚于开始的时刻读作跨到次日：22:30 到 06:30 是一夜的一块，不两块。
en: One time block per row. A time at or before the one it starts at reads as running into the next day: 22:30 to 06:30 is one block, a night, not two.

zh: 一行一条时段。不晚于开始的时刻读作跨到次日，而且整段挂在开始的那一天：周一 22:30 到 06:30 盖住周一夜到周二晨。
en: One time per row. A time at or before the one it starts at reads as running into the next day, and the whole of it hangs on the day it starts: Monday 22:30 to 06:30 covers Monday night through Tuesday morning.

zh: 一行一个可执行文件名。整名对上才算，大小写不算。
